_comment: Example claude_desktop_config.json — copy this into your real config and replace placeholders. Path: ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json on macOS, %APPDATA%/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json on Windows.

monzo._comment_monzo: The Monzo MCP server (samaxbytez/monzo-mcp). Replace MONZO_ACCESS_TOKEN with the value you got from developers.monzo.com. Tokens are short-lived; refresh when needed.

filesystem._comment_fs: Lets the FIRE Ready skill save the report HTML to disk. Replace the path below with a folder you've created on your machine — e.g. ~/Documents/fire-ready-reports.
